Print the resolved config file path.

Part of [`seek config`](seek-config.md).

## Usage

```text
seek config path [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek config path` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek config path --help`:

```text
Usage: seek config path [options]

Print the resolved config file path.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```
